title: M.I.A.Lock Event Pin
description: One documented historical location pin: date × time × event × duration.

duration_seconds.description: Optional explicit duration; otherwise end_at - start_at.

location_uncertainty_m.description: Location uncertainty radius in meters (one ellipse input).

uncertainty_semi_major_m.description: Explicit ellipse semi-major axis in meters.

uncertainty_semi_minor_m.description: Explicit ellipse semi-minor axis in meters.

jurisdiction_footprint_m.description: Jurisdiction grain used as a soft ellipse contribution — not a full-county disk.

time_window_geo_soft_m.description: Time-window geo soft-band in meters (unknown/wide duration expands the ellipse).

doe_descriptor.description: Demographic / circumstance fields on a Doe or unidentified notice. Compatibility only — never an ID.
